name: Mitchell Cole
bio: Mitchell Cole (born March 27, 1994) is an American actor and filmmaker. He is best known for his role as Tyler in the horror film It Ends (2025).

credits.title: 4X4: The Event
credits.overview: Eight contestants enter an illegal sensory-assault livestream where they must kill or be killed using only what they can order online.

credits.title: The Legend of Yella George
credits.overview: A man's wife mysteriously goes missing one night. All evidence points towards the husband. As detectives dive deeper into the case, a local legend begins to twist itself into the case, confusing detectives and the husband. Nightmares, death, and mystery surround this story with an ending no one could see coming.

credits.title: Gobble Gobble
